summary: @wiobyrne I have always been a paper first, keep it on my website than trying the latest and greatest in note taking. I do wish the digital pens were better. I want to archive my paper notes not just put up pictures. i would love an OCR paper/pen system
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: @wiobyrne I have always been a paper first, keep it on my website than trying the latest and greatest in note taking. I do wish the digital pens were better. I want to archive my paper notes not just put up pictures. i would love an OCR paper/pen system
